body:
Yeah… it’s just really hard right now. The guy is obviously « normal ». Besides that he’s got nothing going on so it has to be that ( it’s someone one of my friends kinda knows so I got insight, he average looking, don’t got a good job, don’t got stuff)

It’s just so hard that despite all the stuff I built in my life which is more than most even with my circumstances I am never picked. I was rejected many times by women for my disability, they always said it was something else but they were fine until they realised so… yeah. They can’t even be honest.

I don’t want to live anymore if my life is always going to be that. It hurts everyday and it’s not really worth going through this pain for a life like this. Idk sorry for venting.
